name: dsh-prevent-scd
description: A playful rest-reminder pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Detects late-night or hours-long continuous human operation and blocks the web UI with a cute nurse-cat until you agree to rest. Configurable thresholds, zero external assets, MIT.
stateReasons: ✗ stars 1 / forks 0(需 stars ≥20 或 forks ≥5)
